jobs.title: Equipment Product Marketing Manager - Data Center and Microelectronics
jobs.description:
The Senior Product Marketing Manager – Europe Equipment Portfolio, microelectronics and data center serves as the commercial portfolio owner for Ecolab’s equipment offerings across Europe. Reporting to the High-tech Europe Marketing Director, this role is responsible for defining the market-facing portfolio strategy and roadmap for equipment solutions, including liquid cooling equipment such as coolant distribution units (CDUs), monitoring, and supporting infrastructure used in data center applications.
Portfolio ownership in this role means guiding what problems the Europe equipment portfolio solves, how offerings are structured and differentiated, and how lifecycle decisions are made over time, while partnering closely with Engineering Product Management, R&D, Sales, Marketing and Operations to ensure technical execution and commercialization are aligned. This role supports high-priority growth initiatives across datacenter and microelectronics to shape how the equipment portfolio evolves as customer adoption accelerates.

How you'll make an impact:
- Own the Europe market-facing equipment portfolio roadmap for datacenter and microelectronics, including offering evolution, enhancements, and end-of-life decisions
- Define equipment offering architecture, tiering, configurations, and positioning to support scalable customer deployments across Europe
- Translate market, customer, and competitive insights into clear portfolio priorities and roadmap inputs
- Partner with Global Engineering Product Management to ensure market requirements and customer needs are reflected in the technical roadmap
- Act as an industry-facing equipment subject-matter leader in customer discussions and strategic engagements
- Lead launch readiness and go-to-market execution for new and enhanced equipment offerings
- Support strategic and late-stage sales opportunities, influencing solution design and value articulation
- Create and maintain equipment-specific sales enablement tools, messaging, and commercial guidance
- Coordinate cross-functionally with Global and Europe R&D, Sales, Marketing, Engineering and Operations to ensure commercial and operational readiness
- Contribute to the evolution of the portfolio by identifying opportunities to expand, refine, or simplify offerings over time

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering
- 8+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, product ownership, technical commercialization, or equipment portfolio management
- 3+ years’ experience in industrial capital equipment marketing and/or sales with demonstrated project management skills
- Experience translating complex products into clear, customer-focused offerings and value propositions
- Experience supporting data center, thermal management, or liquid cooling markets

Preferred Qualifications
- Marketing qualification, MBA, or equivalent commercial training preferred
- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, using foresight and judgment to influence portfolio and commercialization decisions
- Experience in developing and launching new products/services
- Experience in product / customer portfolio management
- Ability to relate to influential people and complex organizational structures; strong interpersonal and relationship building skills
- Demonstrated initiative and leadership skills; setting vision and strategy, planning, critical thinking, orchestrating cross-functionally, overseeing multiple project elements and proven track record of results

About Ecolab:
At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to eliminating unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world.
Ecolab’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do what’s right.
Apply today and join one of the most ethical companies with over a hundred years of history.
Join Ecolab and help us protect what’s vital.
#li-eu

The annual pay range for this position is 75,300- 113,100. This position is eligible for annual bonus.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Join CoolIT, an Ecolab Company, a global leader in Direct Liquid Cooling technology for data centers, supercomputers, and high-performance computing environments.

An exciting and challenging position exists as a Technical Program Manager at CoolIT. As a member of the Program Group, you would be accountable for the planning, development and launch of numerous new product introductions (NPI’s)

What’s in it For You
- Health Benefits: Employer-provided benefits coverage begins on the first day of the month following your date of hire. Employees can choose from a selection of medicals plans , along with dental and vision coverage, with premiums shared between the employer and employee.
- Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance: Employee-paid Life and Accidental & Dismemberment (AD&D) coverage
- Disability Coverage: Employer-paid premiums for Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) coverage.
- 401(k) Retirement Plan : 2% employer-sponsored contribution.
- Paid Time Off: Three weeks of paid time off, six flex days, plus a one-week company-wide holiday shutdown.
- Professional Development: $1,000 annually to support professional development and continued learning.
- Work Environment: “Dress for Your Day” in a casual, professional workplace environment.
- Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment

What You Will Do
The Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the Program Core Team and serves as its battle captain, orchestrating cross-functional execution, technical integration, and accountability. Through deep technical understanding and risk-based decision-making, the TPM drives alignment, challenges assumptions, and ensures customer commitments are translated into successful outcomes. This will be a remote role and will be reporting to the Portfolio Manager based in Calgary, Canada.

- Lead the Program Core Team to drive from concept assessment, technical execution, cross-functional integration, customer alignment to NPI launch readiness and be accountable for the success of the overall program/project.

- Build strong customer relationships by understanding business objectives, technical needs, decision drivers, and success criteria; support the KAM in developing new business opportunities and preparing customer proposals.

- Collect, clarify, and translate customer requirements into product requirements, technical scope, PRDs, program plans, and measurable deliverables.

- Drive solution development with engineering teams by challenging assumptions, facilitating design trade-offs, resolving technical issues, and aligning decisions to customer commitments and program risks.

- Support DFMEA activities and broader technical risk assessments across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, supply chain, cost, schedule, and launch readiness.

- Develop and drive mitigation plans, escalation paths, recovery actions, and decision frameworks to protect customer commitments and launch outcomes.

- Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, sales, business stakeholders, and customers to maintain technical alignment, decision velocity, and execution discipline.

- Monitor program health through integrated schedules, dependencies, action registers, risk logs, budgets, and customer-facing status reporting in partnership with Project Managers.

- Travel globally up to 10%-20% to support customer relationship development, requirements reviews, technical reviews, supplier engagement, production readiness, and launch activities.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline, with strong grounding in mechanical, thermal, fluid, or electromechanical product development.

- 5+ years in technical program management, product development, systems engineering, or NPI execution for complex engineered products.

- Proven ability to manage customer relationships, understand customer needs, and translate requirements into PRDs, technical scope, and executable plans.

- Strong engineering collaboration skills, with the ability to drive solution trade-offs across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, cost, and schedule.

- Experience supporting DFMEA, technical risk assessments, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and mitigation planning.
- Excellent communication and influence skills with customers, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, suppliers, and leadership.

We thank every candidate in advance; however, we will contact only those selected for an interview. Please note: immigration sponsorship is not available for this role.
Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks, including criminal record checks and education verification.

ABOUT COOLIT, AN ECOLAB COMPANY
Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.
Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.
As demand for generative AI, high-performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.  #LI-Remote

Annual or Hourly Compensation Range:

$101,400 - $152,100 Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

Ecolab provides the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, auto insurance, home insurance, pet insurance, identity theft protection, short-term and long-term disability, 401k, pension plans, retirement health care benefits, short-term incentives, vacation (12 days), holidays, parental leave, employee stock purchase plans (Full-Time Associates), discount on day care services and caregiver services, adoption assistance, group legal services, employee assistance program, employee discount program, and education assistance program, on-Site childcare and fitness facilities may be available at select Ecolab locations.  Click here  for additional benefits information.  If you are viewing this posting on a site other than our Ecolab Career website, view our benefits at  jobs.ecolab.com/working-here .

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager — Associate Portal
jobs.description:
Ecolab is seeking a highly experienced Technical Product Manager, ServiceNow Associate Portal to serve as the technical product owner and strategic advisor for our enterprise associate experience platform. Built on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro within HR Service Delivery, the Associate Portal will serve as Ecolab’s digital front door, enabling associates to find information, access services, complete tasks, and engage with enterprise workflows through a consistent and personalized experience.
This role will bridge associate needs, product strategy, experience design, and platform capabilities. You will partner closely with Product, HR, Communications, IT, Enterprise AI, UX, Architecture, and business stakeholders to shape the product roadmap and deliver scalable, intuitive, accessible, and supportable associate experiences.
As the technical product leader for the Associate Portal, you will evaluate proposed solutions, guide roadmap and backlog priorities, manage technical tradeoffs, and ensure the product remains aligned with ServiceNow standards and Ecolab’s long-term platform strategy. You will provide technical product leadership throughout the lifecycle, from discovery and design through delivery, deployment, adoption, operations, and continuous improvement.
Reporting to the leader of Technical Product Ownership within the ServiceNow Platform Organization, this role offers significant visibility and the opportunity to influence the future of digital employee experience at Ecolab.
What’s in It for You
- Shape the future of Ecolab’s enterprise associate experience and digital workplace.
- Partner directly with leaders across HR, Communications, Technology, Enterprise AI, and business functions.
- Influence the roadmap for a global Associate Portal built on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro and HR Service Delivery.
- Drive strategic initiatives involving enterprise search, knowledge, content, personalization, workflow automation, conversational assistance, and AI.
- Work within a mature ServiceNow Center of Excellence and collaborate with platform architects, UX leaders, engineering teams, product owners, and business stakeholders.
- Influence enterprise technology decisions supporting how associates find information, access services, and complete work.

What You Will Do
- Serve as the Technical Product Leader for the Associate Portal
- Partner with business product managers, product owners, and stakeholders to translate associate needs and business priorities into scalable ServiceNow product capabilities.
- Establish and maintain a clear product vision, technical product strategy, and roadmap for the Associate Portal.
- Evaluate proposed capabilities and provide guidance on technical feasibility, platform alignment, associate value, maintainability, and long-term product sustainability.
- Identify technical risks, dependencies, integration considerations, and tradeoffs before development begins.
- Facilitate product and design discussions and build consensus across Product, UX, HR, Communications, IT, Architecture, Enterprise AI, and business teams.
- Ensure product decisions balance associate experience, business outcomes, delivery constraints, security, accessibility, global requirements, and ServiceNow platform standards.

Own Product Strategy and Roadmap
- Translate the Associate Portal vision into a prioritized and achievable product roadmap.
- Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, and Engineering to define product capabilities, outcomes, release priorities, and success measures.
- Maintain a clear view of cross-product dependencies involving content, knowledge, search, integrations, identity, data, AI, mobile experiences, and enterprise workflows.
- Evaluate ServiceNow product enhancements and emerging capabilities relevant to Employee Center Pro, HR Service Delivery, enterprise search, content experiences, workflow automation, and associate engagement.
- Develop recommendations for future investments, platform adoption, and product roadmap priorities.
- Balance near-term delivery commitments with platform reuse, upgradeability, technical debt reduction, and long-term product health.

Drive Product Delivery Excellence
- Partner with the Product Owner, Business Analyst, Software Engineering Manager, UX Lead, Architecture, QA, and delivery teams to translate roadmap priorities into epics, features, and an executable backlog.
- Guide backlog prioritization based on associate value, business outcomes, technical readiness, risk, dependencies, effort, and available capacity.
- Participate in discovery, design workshops, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, release planning, user acceptance testing, and go-live readiness.
- Ensure product requirements, approved designs, technical dependencies, data needs, acceptance criteria, and operational expectations are understood before development begins.
- Remain actively engaged throughout implementation, deployment, stabilization, hypercare, and continuous improvement.
- Communicate product status, roadmap decisions, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.

Guide Associate Portal Capabilities
- Provide technical product leadership for Employee Center Pro pages, microsites, navigation, taxonomy, application launchers, search, knowledge, content, services, requests, approvals, tasks, communications, and conversational experiences.
- Guide personalization strategies using personas, audience groups, user criteria, HR criteria, roles, regions, languages, and associate preferences.
- Ensure the product supports intuitive and consistent experiences across desktop, mobile, manufacturing, field, and corporate environments.
- Partner with UX and Engineering to ensure experiences are accessible, responsive, usable, high-performing, and aligned with approved designs.
- Establish reusable product patterns for portal pages, microsites, templates, navigation, taxonomy, targeted communications, and enterprise services.
- Ensure product capabilities support multilingual use, accessibility, frontline environments, privacy, security, and the needs of a global associate population.

Lead Integration and Enterprise Experience Strategy
- Define the product approach for integrations with Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Viva Engage, content and digital asset platforms, EVA, and other enterprise systems.
- Partner with Architecture and Engineering to evaluate integration options, data flows, access models, dependencies, support requirements, and failure scenarios.
- Ensure integration decisions support secure, maintainable, observable, and reusable enterprise patterns.
- Establish clear product ownership and expected associate outcomes for experiences that span ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms.
- Ensure integrations include appropriate monitoring, error handling, support routing, fallback experiences, and operational accountability.

Advance Search, AI, and Automation
- Partner with Enterprise AI, Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to shape the roadmap for enterprise search, conversational assistance, knowledge-grounded responses, and automated task execution.
- Evaluate ServiceNow AI Search, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and workflow automation capabilities where they improve associate outcomes and align with enterprise strategy.
- Define product outcomes and success measures for search relevance, knowledge discovery, conversational experiences, assisted support, and task completion.
- Ensure AI-enabled capabilities meet Ecolab requirements for security, privacy, governance, transparency, performance, observability, and supportability.
- Identify opportunities to simplify associate journeys, reduce friction, improve self-service, and automate repeatable activities.

Own Product Health and Continuous Improvement
- Define and monitor product metrics related to adoption, search effectiveness, task completion, experience quality, content engagement, performance, availability, and operational health.
- Use product analytics, associate feedback, usability findings, support trends, incidents, defects, and operational data to identify improvement opportunities.
- Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor the health of the portal, integrations, search, content, and critical associate journeys.
- Prioritize recurring issues, experience gaps, technical debt, unsupported capabilities, and lifecycle risks within the product roadmap.
- Ensure clear ownership and support boundaries across the Associate Portal and connected enterprise platforms.
- Guide the transition from project implementation to a sustainable internal product and operating model.

Support Content and Experience Governance
- Partner with content leaders and domain owners to establish product capabilities for content creation, approval, publication, personalization, localization, lifecycle management, and archival.
- Guide product decisions involving ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Content Experiences, enterprise content sources, metadata, taxonomy, audience targeting, and searchability.
- Establish clear product governance for portal components, page patterns, microsites, navigation structures, content experiences, and reusable capabilities.
- Ensure decisions involving content migration and disposition support a consistent associate experience and sustainable ownership model.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
- 10 years of experience in enterprise platform management, technical product management, product ownership, or related technology roles.
- Significant hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform.
- Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, capabilities, priorities, and measurable outcomes for an enterprise platform or digital product.
- Experience with ServiceNow Employee Center, Employee Center Pro, Service Portal, HR Service Delivery, Knowledge Management, or closely related capabilities.
- Experience working with product management, UX, architecture, engineering, business analysis, QA, operations, and business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
- Experience guiding enterprise integrations, APIs, data flows, identity, security, and upstream or downstream system dependencies.
- Strong understanding of Agile product delivery, including backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, sprint planning, iterative delivery, release readiness, and user acceptance testing.
- Ability to evaluate technical solutions and communicate platform capabilities, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to technical and nontechnical audiences.
- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.
- Experience supporting global, user-facing enterprise applications with complex business, accessibility, security, content, and integration requirements.
- Ability to balance associate experience, business value, technical feasibility, platform standards, and long-term maintainability.
- No immigration sponsorship available for this position.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience implementing Employee Center Pro or a large enterprise portal, intranet, digital workplace, or employee experience platform.
- ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist in HR Service Delivery or related certification.
- Product management, product ownership, or Agile certification.
- Experience with ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Content Experiences, Curated Experiences, taxonomy, audience targeting, AI Search, analytics, and personalization.
- Experience with ServiceNow Now Assist, Virtual Agent, generative AI, enterprise search, or conversational employee experiences.
- Experience integrating ServiceNow with Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Viva Engage, content platforms, digital asset management solutions, or enterprise AI platforms.
- Experience defining and using product analytics, adoption measures, experience metrics, and operational KPIs.
- Experience supporting a global rollout, content migration, platform modernization, or transition from a systems integrator to an internal product operating model.

Annual or Hourly Compensation Range

The base salary range for this position is $153,900.00 - $230,800.00. This position is eligible for annual bonus pay based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Product Manager will join our MEA & India Nalco Water Product Line Management Team to help our customers meet their goals, drive value delivery to differentiate Ecolab from our competition, and impact the achievement of our ambitious growth targets. The product manager will be responsible for the continuous development of several product lines to enable our customers to meet their operational & sustainability goals and achieve profitable growth for Ecolab.

What will you do?
- Partner with one or more Nalco Water divisions to drive growth by collaborating on the Innovation projects and strategic growth bets.
- Based on an understanding of our customer needs, continuously develop & optimize a portfolio of water treatment products to enable sustainable and profitable growth aligned with divisional priorities/goals and an understanding of our customers’ needs.
- Own a healthy offering with differentiated, cost competitive and regulatory compliant products to create customer value
- Collaborate with global & regional RD&E and divisional marketing teams to develop and commercialize new offerings and to lead cross divisional innovation projects in the IMEA region to meet our financial targets.
- Drive the improvement of the portfolio competitiveness through cost savings/avoidance projects with cross functional teams.
- Support the sales teams with marketing materials such as a product compendium, product selection guides and corresponding training.
- Own competitive intelligence and market analysis to identify market trends to meet unmet customer needs and to propose M&As
- Stay current on market standards, trends and practices and understand impact on Ecolab product line and business.

What’s in it for you:
- Be part of a team managing a portfolio of 500+ products that generate $300M+ of sales across 5 divisions (Light, Heavy, Paper, Mining & Downstream) in a dynamic & high growth region
- The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers with their water, food safety, health and climate goals.
- The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.
- The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best.
- A flexible and autonomous work atmosphere.
- An international company culture where safety is key and offers various possibilities for personal development and career growth.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Education: Chemist, chemical engineer, or related engineering or science educations with a bachelor or master
- 8 years + experience in the water treatment industry.
- Business-to-business marketing experience.
- Ability to relate to influential people and complex organizational structures; strong interpersonal and relationship building skills.
- Project Management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA, preferably in Marketing

- Develop and own the product marketing strategy for wastewater and reclaim offerings in the microelectronics industry.
- Translate customer needs, voice-of-customer input, technical constraints, regulatory trends, sustainability drivers, and competitive intelligence into formal Market Requirements Documents (MRDs).
- Define clear product positioning, value propositions, messaging, and differentiation versus key competitors.

This role will report directly into executive leadership and will serve as the central point of accountability for product definition, scope decisions, and cross-functional alignment. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in digital product development, experience working in or with the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, and a proven ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives in regulated environments.
What you will do
- Own and manage the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technical feasibility.

- Translate business needs, user feedback, and operational insights into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories.

- Serve as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and external development partners, ensuring clarity of scope, priorities, and timelines.

- Coordinate and facilitate cross-functional collaboration across engineering, quality, compliance, and operations teams.

- Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and product reviews with external development teams.

- Track and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to executive stakeholders.

- Support validation planning and documentation efforts in collaboration with quality and compliance leads.

- Champion a user-centered approach to product development, ensuring that the platform meets the needs of its intended users in regulated environments.

Qualifications:
- 8 years of experience in product management or product leadership roles, with a focus on digital platforms or enterprise software.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or Business).

- Experience working in or with regulated industries, ideally pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical devices.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional product development efforts involving external partners or distributed teams.

- Strong understanding of software development processes (Agile, Scrum) and experience working closely with engineering teams.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate between business, technical, and compliance domains.

- Demonstrated ability to make informed trade-off decisions and manage competing priorities.

- No immigration sponsorship is available for this role at this time.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Validation (CSV) principles.

- Experience with cloud-native platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP also valued).

- Exposure to AI/ML-enabled products or edge computing architectures is a plus.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About CoolIT, An Ecolab Company
Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.

Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.

As demand for generative AI, high performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the Program Core Team and serves as its battle captain, orchestrating cross-functional execution, technical integration, and accountability. Through deep technical understanding and risk-based decision-making, the TPM drives alignment, challenges assumptions, and ensures customer commitments are translated into successful outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
-  Lead the Program Core Team, driving technical execution, cross-functional integration, customer alignment, accountability, and NPI launch readiness.

- Build strong customer relationships by understanding business objectives, technical needs, decision drivers, and success criteria; support the KAM in developing new business opportunities and preparing customer proposals.

- Collect, clarify, and translate customer requirements into product requirements, technical scope, PRDs, program plans, and measurable deliverables.

- Drive solution development with engineering teams by challenging assumptions, facilitating design trade-offs, resolving technical issues, and aligning decisions to customer commitments and program risks.

- Support DFMEA activities and broader technical risk assessments across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, supply chain, cost, schedule, and launch readiness.

- Develop and drive mitigation plans, escalation paths, recovery actions, and decision frameworks to protect customer commitments and launch outcomes.

- Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, sales, business stakeholders, and customers to maintain technical alignment, decision velocity, and execution discipline.

- Monitor program health through integrated schedules, dependencies, action registers, risk logs, budgets, and customer-facing status reporting in partnership with Project Managers.

- Travel globally up to 20% to support customer relationship development, requirements reviews, technical reviews, supplier engagement, production readiness, and launch activities.

WHO YOU ARE:

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline, with strong grounding in mechanical, thermal, fluid, or electromechanical product development.

- 5+ years in technical program management, product development, systems engineering, or NPI execution for complex engineered products.

-  Experience supporting DFMEA, technical risk assessments, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and mitigation planning.

Skills:
-  Proven ability to manage customer relationships, understand customer needs, and translate requirements into PRDs, technical scope, and executable plans.

- Strong engineering collaboration skills, with the ability to drive solution trade-offs across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, cost, and schedule.

- Excellent communication and influence skills with customers, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, suppliers, and leadership.

WHY COOLIT?

We strive to be an employer of choice and as such we believe in rewarding our employees with career and development opportunities that will maintain and strengthen our culture while aligning to our vision and values.

We are a company that is full of vibrant, innovative people who love what we do. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
- Vacation and flex days, and paid company-wide shutdown during the holiday season.

- Comprehensive benefits including Dental, Drugs, Optical, Paramedical and Health Spending. These costs are covered by CoolIT and are enacted from your first day.

- Dress for your day – in a casual yet professional environment.

- Retention rewards like “The Big Coffee Break” that reward tenure with additional vacation time and a monetary bonus.

- Company-funded RRSP contributions to support your long-term financial goals.

We thank every candidate in advance, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.  Please note: immigration sponsorship is not available for this role.

Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks including criminal records check and education.

- Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world

- Assist in the creation, deployment, and execution of the site Master Plan

jobs.title: TPM Leader
jobs.location: SAU - Al Mintaqah ash Sharqiyah - Dammam
jobs.description:
TPM Engineer

Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust.

We are seeking to hire a TPM Engineer for driving the Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) program across the plant, ensuring sustainable improvements in equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and employee engagement. This role leads key TPM pillars, building a long term TPM culture in the plant, supports cross‑functional teams, and ensures the plant progresses toward world‑class manufacturing standards.

What’s in it For You:
•     Opportunity for a long-term career path that allows for exposure into all areas of the Ecolab’s supply chain.
•     Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology.
•     Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world.

What You Will Do:

Core Purpose
- Lead and coordinate the plant TPM program inline with site strategy/OGSM and the regional/global TPM program.
- Proactively drive a continuous improvement culture to help realize the site vison.

Core Accountability
-  Ensre plant's TPM implementation is fully aligned to both site master plan and regional/global TPM strategy.
-  Subject matter expert for Plant Manager and plant leadership team on all aspects of TPM governance and deployment.
- Coach and train all site associates in the effective application of TPM tools and techniques to achieve site KPI's.
- Proactively contribute to regional TPM community by developing and sharing best practice.
- Develop and promote loss driven culture through application of appropriate TPM tools and techniques.
- Identify and prioritize areas for continuous improvement through effective audits, benchmarking and gap analysis.

Responsibilities
- Proactively support the delivery of SHE improvements via SHE Pillar ensuring alignment with site master plan.
- Ensure the use of lose analysis across the plant to identify opportunities and priorities actions.
- Support plant team to achieve the KPIs.
- Being the role model for the plant team mainly for the front liners and lead by example.
- Leading the show by spending time on floor for observations, Audit, identifying gaps / defects and actions on time.
- Coach, train and develop all associates in TPM fundamentals and effective application of TPM tools and techniques.
- Being certified as a subject matter expert in TPM according to Ecolab standards.
- Co-create, coordinate and organize plant's TPM steering committee, pillars and teams to ensure consistent deployment and delivery of results aligned with site master plan.
- Ensure TPM philosophy, processes and procedures become fully embedded and integrated into the site's culture and ways of working.
- Proactively contributes to regional TPM community including sharing of best practice, peer review, HPN Sessions and case studies.
- Monitor and report progress against site KPI's to identify and implement improvement programs.
- Be visible and accessible to the operations team, role model company values, vision and promote a continuous improvement culture.
- Lead a group of pillars like the T&PD & 5S pillars; design and implement a competency management system for the plant.
- Help identify losses and/or implement changes to improve products and/or reduce costs.
- Coach TPM pillar teams to develop capability and deliver improvements.
- Develop and train associates in how to develop fundamental TPM tools including 5S, Kaizens, OPLs, SOPs, CIL, checklists and TPM trainings according to Ecolab standards, etc.
- Support all Pillars by being a reference and by providing materials and best practices from the regional or global communities.
- Coach all to implement loss analysis, KAIZENS, develop loss trees and deploy across plant.
- Create and maintain TPM master plan, incorporating benchmarking with other sites.
- Lead the plant towards gold certifications according to the agreed timeline and according to plant master plan/strategy.
- Promote the plant branding and CBN across the plant and elevate the visual management according to the best practices in the plant.

Drives Results
- Consistently delivers tasks on time and targeted quality.
- Recognizes links between role and department results.
- Builds and utilizes network to drive results.
- Prioritizes work based on value to the department.
- Proactively identifies opportunities for process improvements and takes appropriate action.
- Actively seeks out information in areas across site and business.
- Initiates use of the Performance Planning & Development process to achieve personal goals and improve business performance.  Identifies key technical experts and develops relationships to gain in-depth technical knowledge.

Business Insights
- Recognizes key business drivers (i.e. key performance indicators, metrics, OGSM, NPV, MIRR, etc.) and how they link to work plan.
- Demonstrates understanding of Supply Chain work processes (i.e. maintenance, production scheduling, Capacity, C/D, etc.).
- Recognizes markets the company operates in and major competitors.
- Incorporates financial metrics to justify projects (i.e. ROI, etc.).
- Identifies key decision makers in areas of responsibility.

Decision Quality
- Considers multiple aspects of a decision or challenge.
- Develops more detailed alternatives prior to informing of decision.
- Identifies alternatives and makes recommendations to address issues.
- Demonstrates ability to make timely, accurate, and effective decisions.
- Recognizes when to elevate an issue or problem to supervisor.
- Considers best practice approaches internally and externally.

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ Years of Experience in TPM field in a manufacturing plant.
- Working knowledge across Operations in adynamic environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Power Point and Outlook)
- Fluency in English (spoken, written, and reading), with excellent communication skills.
- Analytical thinking, being able to take data-driven and informative decisions.
